ambiguities.explanation: The phrase 'within 2 s' lacks a clear upper bound for the duration of the action. It is ambiguous whether the system must inform the service exactly at 2 seconds, before 2 seconds, or at any point up to and including 2 seconds, as the boundary condition is not explicitly defined.
possible_interpretations: The system shall inform the security service at any time t where t < 2 seconds.
The system shall inform the security service at any time t where t <= 2 seconds.
